reason: The rule it replaces is literally unsatisfiable under exact-commit verification (a records/ commit creating the record moves main and voids the candidate it verified); I lost the same class of landing four times today. This Act keeps the runs, evidence, verdict and pin pre-landing, requires the landed commit to equal the candidate, boundedly copies the state record into Git, is prospective only and claims no waiver. I accept the stated residuals knowingly, especially U1 (pre-landing evidence is off-Git until copied) and U4 (requester is beneficiary), and record that I would prefer the Git-native tree+base design in a future bill.
